Day-to-day activities include conducting market research, generating qualified leads, preparing and delivering proposals and presentations, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding and service delivery. Proven ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment, strong negotiation skills, and a collaborative mindset to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

Job Overview Responsible for the accuracy, integrity, and efficient administration of the organization’s HR Information Systems, leads data cleansing, data entry, and system maintenance activities, manages user access and reporting, and ensures reliable, secure HR data that supports compensation, benefits, workforce planning, and HR decision-making across the organization. Key Responsibilities Data Cleansing & Quality Audit and review employee records across the HRIS on a regular basis to identify duplicates, inconsistencies, and outdated information, then coordinate timely corrective action. Define and enforce data quality standards, validation rules, and periodic cleansing cycles to maintain a single, reliable source of truth for HR data. Data Entry & Maintenance Accurately create, update, and maintain employee master data, turn data into actionable information, including personal information, job/organizational changes, and compensation details — within the HRIS. Ensure all data entries are completed within agreed turnaround times and comply with company policies, audit requirements, and statutory regulations. HRIS System Administration Configure, test, and maintain HRIS modules, workflows, and user access rights to ensure system stability, security, and optimal performance. Liaise with IT and system vendors to troubleshoot issues, manage upgrades and patches, and support integrations with payroll, benefits, and recruitment platforms. Reporting & Analytics Prepare and deliver accurate, timely HR reports and dashboards (headcount, turnover, compensation, etc.) to support the Rewards Director and HR leadership. Design and automate standard and ad-hoc reports using HRIS reporting tools to minimize manual effort and improve data-driven decision-making. Data Security & Compliance Ensure employee data is collected, stored, and processed in full compliance with applicable data protection regulations and internal confidentiality policies. Administer and periodically review user access levels and permissions within the HRIS to safeguard sensitive employee and compensation information. Process Improvement & Support Identify opportunities to automate and streamline HR data processes and workflows, reducing manual work and improving overall data accuracy. Provide first-line support, guidance, and training to HR team members and end-users on HRIS functionalities, data standards, and self-service tools. Other Tasks and Accountabilities Perform additional tasks relevant to the role / area of expertise as requested by management to achieve the objectives and commitments of the department. Act in full compliance with all relevant health, safety, quality and environmental Integrated Management System to guarantee employee safety, legislative compliance, delivery of high-quality products/services and a responsible environmental attitude. Position Requirements (Education & Experience) Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field. Work Experience: 5+ years of experience in HRIS administration, HR data management, or a related field. Skills/Behaviour Competencies Communication skills Attention to detail and accuracy Analytical and problem-solving skills Confidentiality and integrity in handling sensitive data Core Competencies Proficiency in HRIS platforms (e.g., SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, Workday) Advanced Excel and HR data analysis skills Strong knowledge of data privacy and HR data governance practices Ability to translate HR data into actionable insights and reports Proficiency in Zoho Why Join Binghatti? At Binghatti, we do not just build properties—we build legacies. You will join a team driven by ambition, creativity, and excellence, where ideas move fast and every project makes a statement. Here, you will work alongside some of the brightest minds in real estate, contributing to iconic developments that define Dubai’s future. If you are ready to be part of a company that is shaping history, Binghatti is where your story begins.

review_candidates.location: Sharjah, Sharjah Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: Al-Bahar Background Mohamed Abdulrahman Al-Bahar founded in 1937, is a leading business house in the Arabian Gulf with a vision to become the number one provider of customer value in construction equipment, energy and transportation, and materials handling industry. Al-Bahar are dealers of Cat® machinery, heavy equipment and power systems for a wide variety of applications, including earthmoving, building and construction, mining, road making construction, demolition, waste and scrap handling, electric power generation, marine propulsion etc. With more than 2,000 committed employees, Al-Bahar offers a highly engaging and supportive work environment in a culture that values, recognizes and rewards quality performance. Our Human Resources Critical Success Factors are: Continue to build and strengthen intellectual capital by hiring and retaining quality people, rewarding performance, and providing them with growth opportunities. Job Summary The Customer Experience (CX) Analyst will play a key role in embedding a customer-first culture across the organization by designing, managing, and continuously improving customer experience initiatives. This role is responsible for mapping customer journeys, managing feedback programs, driving customer advocacy, and translating CX insights into actionable improvements that enhance satisfaction, loyalty, and business performance. Key Responsibilities Champion a customer-first culture and ensure customer experience best practices are embedded across departments and processes Map, analyze, and optimize end-to-end customer journeys to identify key touchpoints, pain points, and improvement opportunities Manage and track customer experience survey programs, including feedback collection, analysis, and closed-loop follow-up actions Oversee customer advocacy initiatives such as testimonials, case studies, reviews, and referral programs to strengthen brand credibility and trust Promote CX culture through structured training programs, internal communications, and advocacy initiatives Analyze customer experience insights, metrics, and trends, and deliver clear, actionable recommendations to enhance the overall customer experience Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement CX improvements and monitor their impact Track key CX metrics (e.g., NPS, CSAT, CES) and prepare regular performance reports for management Qualifications & Experiences Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Customer Experience, or a related field 5–6 years of experience in customer experience, customer insights, service design, or a related role Hands-on experience with customer journey mapping, survey tools, and feedback management systems Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into practical business insights Experience working in cross-functional environments and driving change initiatives

review_candidates.title: Confectioner
review_candidates.description: Position Summary Responsible to deliver high quality, efficient, individualized and technically excellent pastry preparation in accordance with Company Policies and strictly upholding any Public Health standards and towards a goal of achieving total guest satisfaction. Reporting Structure Reporting to the Executive Chef, Executive Sous Chef and Pastry Chef. Subordinates – Assistant Pastry Chefs. Responsibilities Prepare and present high-quality pastries, desserts, petit fours, and baked goods for all meal services. Collaborate with the pastry team to ensure consistent production and presentation standards. Supervise daily pastry operations and support or replace the Pastry Chef when required. Organize buffet displays, service stations, and special event dessert setups to company standards. Plan production schedules, manage requisitions, and coordinate special orders based on guest demand. Maintain food quality, proper storage, inventory control, and minimize waste through cost-conscious production. Ensure cleanliness, sanitation, and compliance with food safety and public health regulations at all times. Monitor equipment condition, conduct basic maintenance, and report operational issues promptly. Support training, onboarding, and development of pastry team members while fostering positive teamwork. Deliver exceptional guest service, accommodate dietary requirements, and follow all company policies, SOPs, grooming, and conduct standards. Knowledge and experience of Public Health policies and procedures. Ability to read, interpret and demonstrate culinary fundamentals. Physically and medically fit. Language Requirement: Fluent in spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate effectively with guests and crew and follow or provide clear instructions in a multicultural environment.

review_candidates.title: Cluster Manager (Jewellery)
review_candidates.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: We are looking for an experienced and commercially driven Cluster Manager / Area Sales Manager to oversee the performance of multiple jewellery retail stores across Abu Dhabi. The role will be responsible for achieving sales and profitability targets, driving store performance, developing high-performing teams, maintaining exceptional customer service standards, and ensuring operational excellence across the assigned cluster. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in jewellery with a proven track record of managing multiple stores and delivering sales growth. Responsibilities Drive sales and profitability across assigned jewellery stores, achieving monthly, quarterly, and annual targets. Analyse store KPIs including sales, conversion, ATV, footfall, and productivity, and implement corrective action plans. Identify opportunities to increase revenue, customer acquisition, repeat business, and average basket size. Monitor UAE market trends, competitors, pricing, promotions, and customer preferences. Conduct regular store visits to ensure operational, visual merchandising, stock, and customer service standards. Monitor inventory, stock movement, replenishment, ageing stock, and stock accuracy. Lead, coach, and develop Store Managers and sales teams to maximise performance. Set targets, conduct performance reviews, and identify training and development needs. Ensure excellent customer experience, product knowledge, and high standards of jewellery sales service. Manage escalated customer issues and strengthen VIP, CRM, and clienteling activities. Collaborate with merchandising, marketing, and operations teams to drive sales and store performance. Support new store openings, promotions, events, and other retail initiatives. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Retail Management, Marketing, or a related field preferred. 5–10+ years of jewellery sales experience , Proven experience managing multiple stores / a retail cluster . Strong track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets. Excellent leadership, coaching, negotiation, and communication skills. Strong commercial and analytical mindset with the ability to interpret sales and operational KPIs. Excellent knowledge of customer service and luxury retail standards. UAE retail market experience is strongly preferred. Experience working with multicultural teams. Good knowledge of MS Office and retail/POS systems. UAE driving licence is mandatory.
